study type: Cross-sectional comparative study within a cohort
exposure: Elective cesarean delivery by maternal request (CS)
outcome: Proteomic profiles (in amniotic fluid and cord blood)
Metabolomic profiles (in amniotic fluid and cord blood)
cohort: The study participants were 40 healthy pregnant women without complications, including 16 with vaginal delivery, 16 with elective cesarean delivery, and 8 with intrapartum cesarean section.
finding: The mode of delivery significantly impacts the omics composition of biological samples, specifically amniotic fluid proteomics and metabolomics, and cord blood metabolomics.
mod_finding: Amniotic fluid proteomic and metabolomic profiles differed between CS and VD women, Intra_CS proteomic profiles differed from CS, and cord blood metabolomic profiles differed between CS and VD women, while cord blood proteomic profiles showed no separation.
cross-section timing: At the time of delivery, using umbilical cord blood and amniotic fluid samples.
